user.title: Mailbox
user.description: Parcels reads shipping emails through Home Assistant's IMAP integration, which holds the login and the folder (Settings > Devices & services > IMAP > Configure). Pick the IMAP entry that receives your shipping emails. Parcels only reads messages and marks processed ones as read; it never deletes or moves anything.

data_description.imap_entry_id: The scanned folder is the one set in that IMAP entry.

reconfigure.title: Mailbox
reconfigure.description: Pick a different IMAP entry. Parcels reads shipping emails through Home Assistant's IMAP integration, which holds the login and the folder (Settings > Devices & services > IMAP > Configure). Pick the IMAP entry that receives your shipping emails. Parcels only reads messages and marks processed ones as read; it never deletes or moves anything.

data_description.imap_entry_id: The scanned folder is the one set in that IMAP entry.

tracking.title: Tracking (optional)
tracking.description: Live tracking is optional: without it, parcels still come from the emails. A free 17TRACK account (17track.net) gives live carrier updates. A free Ship24 API key (ship24.com) lets Parcels join a parcel handed from an export carrier to the local carrier. Leave everything empty to skip.

data_description.seventeentrack_username: The email address of your 17TRACK account.
data_description.seventeentrack_password: Leave blank to keep the current password when editing.
data_description.ship24_api_key: Optional. Checked when you save. Leave blank to keep the current key when editing.

ai.title: AI for email details
ai.description: The rule parser finds carrier, tracking number and status. An AI can additionally read the item, order lines, merchant and delivery window. Choose none to use the rules only.

data_description.ai_mode: Rules only, a Home Assistant AI Task entity, or an Ollama server.

ai_task.title: AI Task entity
ai_task.description: Pick the AI Task entity that reads the emails. Email text is sent to the service behind it.

data_description.ai_task_entity: Any entity of the AI Task integration that supports generating data.

ollama.title: Ollama server
ollama.description: Parcels asks the server's /api/chat. The URL and model are checked against /api/tags.

data_description.ollama_model: A model that is already pulled on the server.
data_description.ollama_api_key: Optional. Leave blank to keep the current key when editing.

home.title: Home address check (optional)
home.description: A parcel whose emails name another address is not counted as arriving today. Leave empty to turn the check off.

data_description.home_postcode: A UK postcode decides when an email names one.
data_description.home_names: Comma-separated names your orders use for the delivery address, for example the name on an Amazon address-book entry.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the mailbox through that IMAP entry. Check the IMAP integration (login and folder).
error.imap_not_loaded: That IMAP entry is not loaded. Fix it under Settings > Devices & services > IMAP first.
error.invalid_auth: The server refused the login. Check the username and password.
error.ship24_unreachable: Could not check the key: Ship24 did not answer as expected. Try again later.
error.model_not_found: That model is not available on the server. Pull it first.

abort.legacy_entry: This entry uses the Home Assistant imap, ollama and seventeentrack integrations; there is nothing to change here.
abort.no_imap: Add the IMAP integration first (Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > IMAP), then add Parcels.

delivered.name: Delivered parcels
delivered.description: Delivered or received parcels with their order lines (merchant, order number, items), oldest first. Returns a response.

since.name: Since
since.description: Only parcels delivered at or after this time (default: the last 30 days).

received.name: Received
received.description: Confirm a parcel was received (or undo).

slot.name: Slot
slot.description: Row number in the list instead of an id.

follow_up.name: Follow up
follow_up.description: Flag or unflag a parcel for follow-up (toggles without flag).

flag.name: Flag
flag.description: True to flag, false to clear; omit to toggle.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Shown with the flag (default: Follow up).

merge.name: Merge
merge.description: Merge a possible duplicate into another parcel.

remove.name: Remove
remove.description: Delete a parcel (not a parcel: wrong match, spam).

scan.name: Scan
scan.description: Check the mailbox, retry pending emails and refresh 17TRACK now.

reload_rules.name: Reload rules
reload_rules.description: Read rules.yaml and parcels_rules.yaml (in the Home Assistant config folder) again. A wrong file raises a repair and keeps the previous rules.

test_email.name: Test email
test_email.description: Run the email rules on a made-up email and return what they read (status, carrier, tracking numbers, date...). Nothing is stored.

date.name: Date
date.description: When the email was sent (default now).

rules_invalid.title: Parcels rules file is wrong
rules_invalid.description:
The built-in rules are used until this is fixed: {error}

Correct parcels_rules.yaml in the Home Assistant config folder, then run the action Parcels: Reload rules.
